title: Commodities 1-Week Breakout Strategy

rules.breakout_condition: Close breaks 10D high (BUY) / low (SELL), max overshoot 3.00%
rules.filter_mode: Trend regime: BUY close>SMA50>SMA200, SELL close<SMA50<SMA200 | Breakout: 10D high/low with max overshoot 3.00% | Volume: volume > SMA(20) x 1.50 | RSI: BUY 55.0-75.0, SELL 25.0-45.0 | ATR%: 1.00 to 6.00 | Market gate: disabled | Slope filter: disabled | Relative strength filter: disabled | Candle position filter: disabled | Range expansion filter: (high-low)/ATR14 >= 1.10 | Squeeze filter: STD10/STD50 <= 0.90 | Breadth filter (>%SMA50): BUY >= 0.45, SELL <= 0.45

notes: Non-EMA momentum strategy with extended quality gates for range expansion, squeeze, slope and breadth.
Designed to improve 1-week move quality by reducing weak breakout entries.
Telegram latest-trade alert is handled by backend strategy notifier using item notify_key signatures.
